## Notes for Agents

- Prefer canonical clean URLs without `.html`.
- Spanish content uses the root path.
- English equivalents use `/en/`.
- Search, assessment, calculators, contact, and booking experiences are interactive.
- Use the website's WebMCP tools when available.
